subject: physical-education
unitTitle: Independent Training Cycle: Plan, Execute, Adjust
title: Synthesis and review: diagnosing a stalled cycle under transfer
essentialQuestion: Can I run a full cycle without anyone checking on me?
materials: space and equipment appropriate to the goal
privacySafeScenario: Run a complete self-directed training cycle end to end, documenting every adjustment and its reason, and write an honest evaluation of what worked and what did not.
studentTask: Learner works diagnosing a stalled cycle run unsupervised across a full cycle, with the pre-committed rules honoured rather than renegotiated mid-cycle at a self-set intensity, then records what held, what degraded first, and how this occasion differed from the earlier one.
knowledgeCheck: In one concise response, say which feature of diagnosing a stalled cycle degraded first under the added demand, why, and what you would change before the next attempt.
completionCriteria: The learner holds diagnosing a stalled cycle run unsupervised across a full cycle, with the pre-committed rules honoured rather than renegotiated mid-cycle, in whatever version their body and setting allow.
The learner names what degraded first and why, rather than reporting only whether it worked.
The learner compares this occasion with the earlier one and says what actually changed.
adaptationChoices: Goal, modality, and volume are the learner’s; any medical restriction is planned around with guardian input.
extensionChallenge: Design the next progression of diagnosing a stalled cycle yourself, or coach the transfer condition to someone else so that they succeed with it — without completing another learner's graded work.
accessibilitySupports: Provide readable text plus optional audio or read-aloud support; no voice feature is required.
Chunk directions into one action at a time and show a worked example or model.
Allow typed, handwritten, spoken, drawn, demonstrated, or described responses when the standard permits.
Offer reduced-copying, extended-time, hidden-timer, rest-break, and low-distraction options.
Use captions, alt text, high-contrast print, keyboard access, and text-only fallbacks for media.
Preserve the learning target while adjusting quantity, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, or response mode.
Every movement task has a seated, supported, reduced-range, reduced-pace, and solo version that reaches the same standard.
Goal, modality, and volume are the learner’s; any medical restriction is planned around with guardian input.

optionalReflection.prompt: Invite the learner to notice where diagnosing a stalled cycle shows up outside the session under real conditions. No purchase, account creation, photograph, recording, or public performance is required.

neverRequires: This task never requires body weight, height, BMI, or body-fat percentage.
This task never requires calorie counting or a diet or weight-loss goal.
This task never requires disclosing private medical history, a diagnosis, or sexual history.
This task never requires a photograph, video, or voice recording of the learner as proof.
This task never requires a public performance or an audience.
